4) Timeline & procurement: any procurement timeline constraints or doc review windows we should know about? If procurement wants to be looped in, drop the contact and I'll include them in the MAP.

I attached a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) and our standard pricing matrix so you have context. If you can reply with the volume numbers and target $/1M tokens, I'll pull a formal discount proposal (startup + committed tiers) and next steps.

Thanks, I'll follow up internally once I have your numbers.

Thanks for the context. Quick rec: for early-stage startups + this volume profile I'd recommend the following talk track and numeric options we can present today:

- List price: $150 / 1M tokens (our standard baseline for the model mix they described).
- Startup program: $20k in platform credits, usable over first 3 months, plus onboarding support (no charge) - this is standard for Series A qualifiers.
- Committed-use discounts (applied on list): 6-month commit => 20% off, 12-month commit => 35% off. For Nimble's expected steady-state (~100-120M/mo) the 12-month discount yields an effective ~$97.50 / 1M tokens (35% off $150). If they want additional multi-year incentives we can layer an extra 5% for >24-months or larger $ commitments.

Negotiation flexibility: for budget-constrained startups we can push a blended approach: smaller monthly commit with a larger onboarding credit to hit their initial $8-$14k/mo target in months 1-3, then roll into the committed discount once volume stabilizes.

Legal/Procure notes: procurement@nimbleai.com will want a standard MSA + SOW and DocuSign link - fine to send once they accept the commercial terms.

If you'd like, I can draft an offer email and MAP with numbers called out.


Rishi

Option A - Startup + Pilot (lowest near-term cost)
- $20k in Redwood credits applied over first 3 months (startup program).
- No upfront commit; pay-as-you-go at list $150 / 1M tokens until credits exhausted.
- Good if you need minimal procurement friction.

Option B - 12-month committed (predictable unit economics)
- 12-month term, target steady commit: 100M tokens / month (we can set a flexible band +/- 20%).
- 35% off list => effective $97.50 / 1M tokens.
- $20k startup credits still applied in months 1-3 to help hit initial budget target.
- DocuSign MSA/SOW link and MAP attached - procurement can review.

We can also do a 6-month commit (20% off) if you want shorter-term proof.

Next steps: 1) Let me know which option you prefer or if you want a blended commitment pattern; 2) if procurement wants the legal packet I'll send the DocuSign. We can have a final commercial approval by Fri if that works for you.
